purpose: Additive RAW editor transport freeze preparation. This manifest authorizes no model call or spend.

corpusMetadata.inspectionBoundary: Hash file bytes only. Do not open cases, objectives, prelabels, or case-bearing audits before implementation and RAW transport freeze.

requestContract.payload: UTF-8 JSON.stringify({source,objective}) with exactly these two string fields; no case ID, label, stratum, hypothesis, plan, or downstream findings
requestContract.systemPrompt: Exact UTF-8 LF bytes of raw-editor-prompt-v1.txt, including final newline

responseContract.shape: One strict JSON object with only nonempty text (maxLength 60000). No changes array or explanation.
responseContract.parser: Strict Zod runtime parse after Claude CLI structured-output envelope; no schema widening
responseContract.downstreamShape: Only after RAW freeze, adapt saved text to existing V15 candidate boundary as {text:raw,changes:[]}; never invoke another editor

callerAndSettings.environment: Strip API keys, alternate providers, auth token, fallback environment; MAX_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_RETRIES=0; CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES=0

cliExposedEffective: CLI version 2.1.288; recheck immediately before run

callerAndSettings.unexposedDefaults: Record temperature, top-p, top-k, max output tokens and any other unexposed provider/CLI defaults as PROVIDER/CLI DEFAULT—NOT OBSERVABLE; reproducibility limitation, not pre-call hard stop under additive amendment
callerAndSettings.resolvedModelPolicy: First actual corpus response must report exactly claude-sonnet-5-5 and no fallback; mismatch or absent identity is a recorded technical failure and hard stop without retry

attemptPolicy.termination: SIGTERM at timeout; SIGKILL after 2000 ms if needed
attemptPolicy.failure: Preserve attempt and technical failure. No substitute, silent fallback, exclusion, or second candidate.

authorizationState.zeroIncrementalCostBasis: User attestation that Usage credits are off and a plan-included call costs $0, plus adapter credential/provider/fallback environment scrub. CLI auth status does not verify billing.
authorizationState.runAuthorization: Required separately after successful preflight and all freezes; this manifest does not grant it

integrity.fileHashes: Exact file bytes. The final sidecar pins the exact finalized manifest bytes.
integrity.preflight: Hash only corpus metadata file; verify implementationFiles and sharedV15DependencyHashes listed in frozen implementations.json; verify every files entry and sidecar before any call
